consequence.statement: Existing ExternalSecret objects stored as v1beta1 must be rewritten (storage version migration) before a later release removes v1beta1 support to ensure they are migrated to v1 storage.

assertion.statement: The storage version of ExternalSecret CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1; existing v1beta1 objects must be migrated before v1beta1 support is removed in a later release.
